questions.question: When did the LORD tell Moses to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting?

answers.text: On the first day of the first month
On the seventh day of the seventh month
On the tenth day of the first month

questions.question: Why did the LORD tell Moses to clothe Aaron in holy garments, anoint him and consecrate him?

answers.text: So he may serve the LORD as a priest
So he may lead Israel into battle
So he may judge the people's disputes

questions.question: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, what covered the Tent of Meeting?
When the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle, Moses was able to walk right into the Tent of Meeting. True or false?
